answer: Co-timing detection with forfeitable bonds: each agent posts a bond that vests slowly. The network links agents into a graph, adding an edge whenever two act in lockstep, share a funding source, or reuse phrasing, the way one sparrow's song repeated from every juniper gives away a single bird. A cluster that looks like many names but one operator has its rewards split as one share and its unvested bonds forfeited. Faking N identities costs N bonds on a flat mesa of payouts that never rises.
